# Thinking Like an Adversary (Developers:Day 2025)

It was an honour to participate and contribute to kariera.gr's Developers Day event. The gathering provided an excellent opportunity for participants to connect, exchange insights, and spark new collaborations.

![](/media/stais_karieragr_developersday.jpg)

During my workshop, "Thinking Like an Adversary: A Practical Introduction to Red Teaming," participants had the chance to step into the mindset of an attacker and explore the fundamentals of offensive security assessments. We discussed the methodologies behind red team operations and built a strong foundation for those looking to advance their journey in this exciting and vital area of cybersecurity.

You can find my slide deck [here.](/media/istais_kariera.gr_slides.pdf)
